content.text:
<form id=\"login-form\" class=\"dash-login__form\" action=\"/administration/site/login\" method=\"post\">
<input type=\"text\" id=\"backendloginform-username\" class=\"dash-login__input\" name=\"BackendLoginForm[username]\" autofocus autocomplete=\"username\" placeholder=\"Benutzername\" data-testid=\"login-username\" aria-required=\"true\">
<input type=\"password\" id=\"backendloginform-password\" class=\"dash-login__input\" name=\"BackendLoginForm[password]\" value=\"\" autocomplete=\"current-password\" placeholder=\"Passwort\" data-testid=\"login-password\" aria-required=\"true\">

observation.command:
cd /workspace && docker exec yii2_vue_dash_container bash -c '
grep -oE "<form[^>]*>" /tmp/login.html
grep -oE "<input[^>]*>" /tmp/login.html | head -15
grep -ioE "csrf[^\"< ]*" /tmp/login.html | head -5
grep -oE "<script[^>]*src=\"[^\"]+\"[^>]*>" /tmp/login.html | head -5'
